description: Time Charter of Two Harbour Tugs for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Following a comprehensive evaluation of the requirement of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, the Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-01-06, granted approval for time charter of 02 Nos. of 70 Ton Bollard Twin Azimuth Stern Drive Harbour Tugs for a specific period of time with the aim of increasing the tug fleet of the Authority. As per the said Cabinet decision, bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding method to select a suitable supplier, and 03 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to procure the said 02 harbour tugs from M/S Sri Lanka Shipping Company Limited, substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a period of 05 years at a cost of US$ 17.16 million (excluding applicable Taxes and Duties), based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
